---
title: "Twitter Card image size options are deprecated"
image: page.png
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'twitter-card.*image-width.*image-height.*deprecated.*open-graph'
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://example.com/page.png">'
        -
          - 'twitter:image-height'
          - 'twitter:image-width'
---

The site sets `image-width` and `image-height` under `twitter-card`, which Twitter Cards have no tags for.

The test renders this file alone, not the whole project first: the warning is printed once per Quarto process, so a project pre-render would consume it.
